import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc

STATES = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]
campaign = {
  "types": [
    {"name": "St", "kind": "enum", "values": STATES},
    {"name": "Msg", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
    {"name": "Small", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "Flag", "kind": "bool"}
  ],
  "modules": [
    {"name": "job", "params": [["state", "St"], ["msg", "Msg"], ["k", "Small"]],
     "result": ["r", "Flag"], "requires": None}
  ],
  "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["job"],
  "machine": {
    "states": STATES, "initial": "A",
    "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg",
    "transitions": [
      # cost tie between two 2-hop routes to D: aa.. < bb..
      {"from": "A", "to": "B", "command": "bb", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "A", "to": "C", "command": "aa", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "B", "to": "D", "command": "zz", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      {"from": "C", "to": "D", "command": "yy", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      # equal cost but fewer hops wins over lexicographic order
      {"from": "A", "to": "E", "command": "zzz", "cost": 2, "when": None},
      {"from": "A", "to": "F", "command": "mmm", "cost": 2, "when": None},
      {"from": "F", "to": "E", "command": "nnn", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      # guarded cheap edge: only usable when k == 3
      {"from": "A", "to": "D", "command": "cheap", "cost": 1,
       "when": ["eq", ["var", "k"], ["const", "Small", 3]]},
      # cycle back to A so that long detours exist
      {"from": "D", "to": "A", "command": "back", "cost": 1, "when": None},
      # guard making the only route to F depend on k
      {"from": "C", "to": "F", "command": "only", "cost": 1,
       "when": ["lt", ["var", "k"], ["const", "Small", 9]]}
    ]
  },
  "runs": []
}
runs = []
for state, msg, k in [("D", "q", 0), ("E", "e", 0), ("D", "q", 3), ("F", "f", 8),
                      ("F", "f", 9), ("A", "z", 0), ("D", "zz", 1), ("A", "ab", 4)]:
    padded = msg + '\x00' * (2 - len(msg))
    objs = [("x0", enc(STATES.index(state), 4))]
    objs += [("x%d" % (2 + i), enc(ord(c), 1)) for i, c in enumerate(padded)]
    objs += [("x4", enc(k, 1)), ("x5", enc(1, 1))]
    runs.append({"entry": "job", "ktest": ktest(objs)})
campaign["runs"] = runs
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
